notes:
Top-level: large dev org (monorepo, 700+ active devs) evaluating Redwood for their IDE copilot and code search. Key asks: extremely low-latency streaming for completions (<50ms p95 ideal), aggressive cost controls per-seat, and deployability inside a VPC/air-gapped-friendly option.

Shorthand from calls: "we need predictable monthly run-rate not surprise token bills"; platform lead: "can you guarantee degraded fallback that still keeps typing experience live?".

Technical details captured: prototype uses small prompt windows (avg 40 tokens) but many short completions (~1.2M completions/month estimated). Interested in prefix/KV caching across shared code contexts (repo-level caches) to reduce repeated token churn; embedding-based code search to reduce assistant calls. Explicit ask for quantization profiles: compare int8 vs int4 per-model perf and quality.

Cost concerns: per-seat unit economics — they want a model where heavy users are capped (circuit-breaker), ability to hard-pin a cheaper quantized model for bulk users and premium unquantized for senior engineers. Also care about model pinning/versioning for reproducibility of completions across releases.

Security/compliance notes: must integrate SSO (SAML) with SCIM; need audit logs of prompts and redaction options; KMS for key material. Data residency: EU code must not leave EU for EU team.

Quote from EngMgr on 2026-02-10: "If we can get 50ms p95 and a clear savings plan, we can convert a majority of dev seats in Q3."
